description: Land Aquisition - Gangodawila, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District,  Land Aquisition - Thumbowila South, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District, Land Aquisition - Correction Paper. Werahera. Boralasgamuwa  Sec 07
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public projects (storm water drainage, access roads, water reserves), provides detailed land descriptions including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information, and includes corrections to previous land acquisition notices. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters.
